newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen soft, tone cautious on rupiah.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen soft, tone cautious on rupiah.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen soft on Thursday as the rupiah was more volatile in early trade on a spillover of regional nervousness, brokers said.
"The rupiah has become more volatile again. Sentiment is likely to be cautious due to the rupiah volatility," one broker with a large brokerage firm said.
Brokers said Lippo Cikarang was likely to attract attention as the property firm was scheduled to be listed on Thursday.

They said Indofood and Indocement were also likely to attract attention as critics have labelled Indocement's proposed stake sale in Indofood to Singapore-based QAF Limited as capital flight amid the falling rupiah against the dollar.
On Wednesday, the Jakarta composite index ended up 6.75 points, or 0.95 percent, at a day high of 718.19 points.
"Lippo Cikarang's strong debut had been expected as the issue had been traded at around 1,050 rupiah in the grey market," another broker said.
Pharmaceutical firm Darya Varia, however, remained under selling pressure following news reports that the firm was expected to post poor first half results, brokers said.
Darya fell 100 rupiah to 1,925 rupiah, with some 2.3 million shares traded.
